source.note: English is a Quillbot paraphrase of the clinical handbook; Burmese was human-translated by university students; Thai is Google Translate output. Whitespace removed from Thai and Burmese for display.

notes: KNOWN ERROR in the machine Thai: it says 'phlegm in the blood' instead of 'blood in the phlegm'. Left in on purpose as a reviewer test case; status is 'machine' so it is shown to the volunteer with a warning and never to the patient.
